_evidence: Language-name table: 0x0054e33d resets [0x838b91] to 0, stores one string pointer per accepted *.str file at [count*4 + 0x838b99] (inc [0x838b91]) and stops at 11 (cmp [0x838b91],0xb / jae), so the count is 0..11 and the first count entries are non-null pointers to NUL-terminated names (chars_00838b99). 0x0054e456/0x0054e491 read ecx = [0x838b91] (or ecx,ecx / je: 0 skips everything) and edi = [ebx], ebx += 4 per string. All 11 slots get valid pointers so any count is safe.
